# platform.AdminAgent

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A registered agent for staff: its role, subagents, tools, skills, permission ceiling and whether organizations enable it.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `platform.AdminAgent` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `platform` |
| Permission | `platform.agent.manage` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | yes | `none` | What the agent does, as registered (English, from code). |  |
| `enablement` | yes | `none` | `always`, or `per-organization` when the organization's agent settings decide. |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | Agent id (module agents are prefixed by the module id). |  |
| `name` | yes | `none` | Name the runtime registered (English, from code). |  |
| `permissions` | yes | `none` | Its ceiling: the permissions its tool calls may ever use (the caller's permissions narrow them). |  |
| `role` | yes | `none` | `supervisor`, `entry` or `subagent`. |  |
| `skills` | yes | `none` | Names of the core skills it loads; skills of enabled modules come on top. |  |
| `subagents` | yes | `none` | Ids of the agents it may delegate to (the supervisor); the organization's settings narrow them per run. |  |
| `tools` | yes | `none` | Ids of the tools it has in every organization. |  |
| `toolsVaryByOrganization` | yes | `none` | True when it also gets tools from the organization's connectors or web opt-ins. |  |

## Relations

_None._

```json
[
  {
    "id": "knowledge",
    "name": "Knowledge",
    "description": "Answers questions about the organization's documents and data catalog from the knowledge base, citing every claim.",

    "enablement": "per-organization",
    "subagents": [],
    "tools": [
      "knowledge.searchKnowledge"
    ],
    "toolsVaryByOrganization": false,
    "skills": [
      "knowledge-citations"
    ],

      "core.knowledge.read",
      "core.catalog.read"
    ]
  }
]
```
